title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (LATAM Only)
description:
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer

Location: Remote — Brazil/US time zones (EST ±3h) • Contract: International contractor, $35/hour • Language: English (fluent) • Reports to: CTO & Engineering team.



About the role

Volatus is hiring a Senior Fullstack Engineer to own critical product work on a next‑generation platform for fertility clinics and their patients. You will join as a founding engineer, shaping both the product and the technical direction in a category where better software directly improves patient outcomes.


Tech context

You will work in a modern, greenfield stack centered on:

  • Frontend: Next.js/React , Typescript , Tailwind CSS
  • Backend: Node.js/TypeScript with a PostgreSQL core (schema design, authN,authZ, performance, transactions, triggers).
  • Data & integrations: Third-party API integrations ; performance profiling (e.g., Lighthouse).
  • Quality: Unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; CI/CD .
  • Collaboration: Work closely with our Head of Engineering, Principal Engineer, Product Designer, and CEO.


What you will do

  • Build and ship end‑to‑end features across the Next.js frontend and Node/TypeScript backend. 
  • Model and tune Postgres schemas; ensure secure authN/authZ and strong performance. 
  • Integrate external APIs and improve app reliability and speed (including Lighthouse‑driven improvements). 
  • Write reliable tests (unit/integration/e2e) and contribute to CI/CD workflows. 
  • Make pragmatic early‑stage architectural decisions and raise the engineering bar.


What you will bring

  • Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate development and quality. 
  • Strong production experience with Next.js/React, Node.js, and TypeScript.
  • Tailwind & CSS mastery; responsive, accessible UI. 
  • PostgreSQL expertise (modeling, security/auth, performance, transactions, triggers). 
  • Integrations experience (third‑party APIs) and solid testing practice (unit/integration/e2e). 
  • Portfolio or links to shipped projects/code.


90-day outcomes

In your first 90 days, you will:

  • Lead at least one significant feature from design to production, used by real clinics or internal teams.​
  • Improve a key part of the frontend experience (e.g., performance, usability, or design consistency) and document the standards for others.​
  • Own part of the backend or data model, including at least one meaningful performance or reliability improvement.​
  • Help define or refine testing and deployment practices so the team can ship faster and with more confidence.


Nice to have

  • Experience building voice‑controlled components / speech‑to‑text. 
  • Experience interacting with AI models from the web app.


How we work

  • Remote within EST ±3 hours preferred ; open to other time zones if you can collaborate on US‑friendly hours.
  • Small, senior team with a strong bias toward action and ownership ;
  • Product-led culture : engineers are closely involved in discovery, tradeoff discussions, and shaping the roadmap.


Hiring process

  • Coderpad Challenge (60 min)
  • Intro chat (45 min) – mutual fit and role context.
  • Technical deep‑dive & Live testing – discuss systems you’ve built; pair on a focused problem (no whiteboard trivia).
  • Team conversation – meet engineering + product leadership.
  • References & offer.


Volatus is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Sr. Product Analyst
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our flag ship product is a Chromium browser, that provides a powerful and secure way to search the web; and our growing ecosystem includes a portfolio of innovative mobile products. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities

  • Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
  • Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
  • Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
  • Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
  • Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiency


Personality Traits

  • People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
  • They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
  • They have strong time/priority management skills
  • They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA’s, User Acquisition, and Design teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify key metrics and measure the success of product initiatives
  • Understands the differences between team level updates and executive level updates


Experimentation & Optimization

  • Support A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to validate hypotheses and inform product decisions
  • Analyze experiment results and recommend next steps for product improvements


Agile/Scrum Processes

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to align analytics work with product development priorities
  • Deliver insights in iterative cycles that align with Agile methodologies


Who You Are


  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or similar)
  • 5+ years of firsthand experience in management/analysis of data within a Structured Query Language (SQL) database (Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift) with proven SQL and query writing skills

  • Demonstrated ability to extract and assimilate data from multiple sources and communicate analysis in a concise, easy-to-understand, and actionable format
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and working in iterative development cycles

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

title: Strategic Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
The Vision


At AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a \"thinking partner\" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.


Who We’re Looking For


The Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's \"20% focus\" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.

You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who \"just gets it\" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.



Why You Should Join Us


  • AI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
  • Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
  • High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.


Role Responsibilities


The 20% That Drives 80% of Success

  • Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero \"emotional leakage\".
  • Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
  • Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
  • Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.

The Remaining 80%

  • HubSpot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
  • SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
  • Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.


Skills & Attributes We're Looking For


  • Methodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
  • 1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
  • Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
  • Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
  • Coachability : You believe feedback is the \"breakfast of champions\" and iterate quickly based on guidance.


Our Values


  • Create remarkable experiences – Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
  • Always be growing – Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
  • Deliver results – Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
  • Do the right thing – Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
  • Practice what we teach – Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.

Compensation & Location


  • Compensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
  • Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).


Application & Selection Process


TO APPLY:

  • Send your Resume (PDF titled \"Lastname.Firstname.EA.pdf\") to (Operations+ ).
  • Record a short demo video (2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights: Process Optimization Proposal: Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.


Our process is thorough but rewarding. Here is what you can expect:

  • Technical AI Prompt Test and Strategic Thinking Exercise
  • Behavioral Assessments : Working Genius (to assess natural strengths) and Kolbe A Index.

Three-Step Interview sequence : Initial Screening call → Head of Operations → CEO.

title: Senior Product Experience Designer (Remote) - B2B Healthtech SaaS
description:
• Ongoing contract role · 10 hours per week · Remote (Brazil Based)
  • Flexible hours · PST time zone overlap preferred
  • International team across Brazil and North America
  • 5+ years of designing SaaS web applications (required)
  • Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
  • Fluent English required - written and spoken


About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Experience Designer to help shape the user experience of a SaaS web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.


This role is intentionally scoped at 10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused on senior-level product experience design - the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.


This role is well suited to someone who:

  • enjoys focused, high-impact work,
  • may already have other professional commitments,
  • and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.


You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to design end-to-end product experiences — from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.


This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.


About Optive

We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.


Our team works across two closely related platforms:

  • Optive - a patient engagement and care platform
  • Optimal DX - an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners today


You’ll contribute experience design work across both platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.


Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.



What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end user journeys for complex SaaS web applications
  • Translate product goals into clear workflows, flows, and wireframes
  • Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
  • Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
  • Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
  • Communicate clearly with an international team in English , both written and spoken


Why this Role Might be a Fit

  • Have 5+ years of experience designing customer-facing SaaS products or complex web applications
  • Have worked on products that real customers use in production
  • Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
  • Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
  • Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
  • Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
  • Can overlap some working hours with PST
  • Communicate fluently in English


Preferred Background

While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:

  • Designed complex SaaS or web applications used in production
  • Owned or heavily influenced end-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
  • Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
  • Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2B, or data-heavy products)
  • Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impact


If your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.


Proof Matters

We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:

  • Screenshots of shipped SaaS products
  • Annotated flows or wireframes
  • Case studies explaining experience design decisions
  • Clear examples of problems you personally solved


We understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who can point to real experience design work and talk concretely about the decisions behind it.


How to Apply

Apply via LinkedIn.


Please include:

  • A short note about your experience designing SaaS or web applications
  • Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
  • Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience


Applications without clear experience in SaaS or web-based product design will not be considered.

description:
Senior Tech Sourcer


Summary

We’re looking for an experienced Tech Sourcer to join Kake’s internal team and help build our sourcing function from the ground up. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing and executing sourcing strategies for technical roles, partnering closely with recruiters, and building strong talent pipelines. If you enjoy deep sourcing, proactive outreach, and shaping scalable processes, we’d love to hear from you.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner with recruiters during role kick-offs to align on hiring needs, must-haves, dealbreakers, and sourcing strategy.
  • Own end-to-end technical sourcing for new roles, building and maintaining strong candidate pipelines.
  • Design and execute sourcing strategies using Boolean search, headhunting, talent mapping, and targeted company research.
  • Create tailored outreach messages to attract and engage high-quality technical candidates.
  • Conduct initial profile and pre-screening assessments, identifying fit, gaps, and potential risks early in the process.
  • Manage sourced candidates in the ATS, ensuring accurate tracking, stage updates, and smooth handoff to recruiters.
  • Maintain consistent communication with candidates, supporting scheduling and follow-ups when needed.
  • Contribute to building sourcing processes, best practices, and documentation as the function scales.


Core Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in technical sourcing or talent sourcing roles.
  • Strong experience sourcing for technical profiles across different stacks and seniority levels.
  • Proven ability to build pipelines from scratch using proactive sourcing techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with Boolean search, LinkedIn sourcing, and ATS tools.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment.


Nice to Have

  • Experience helping to build or scale a sourcing function.
  • Familiarity with market mapping and talent intelligence.
  • Experience working closely with recruiters in high-growth environments.


Other Traits

  • Proactive and curious, with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving priorities.
  • Collaborative mindset and strong stakeholder partnership skills.
  • Passion for continuous improvement in sourcing strategies and processes.


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we’re the destination.The icing on the Kake:


  • Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.
  • Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.
  • Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.
  • Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: JavaScript Engineer — 3D Web Developer
description:
Who We Are Seeking

We seek a talented and experienced Full-Stack JavaScript Developer with 3D experience to join our international team. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. We seek an energetic, driven, and articulate team player who is truly passionate about their work.



Role and Responsibilities


  • Architecture & Hands-on Development: Technical design and delivery of new features across the TypeScript codebase (React/Next.js and Node.js).


  • Core 3D Configurator: Architecting a high-performance web scene (Three.js/Babylon.js) to load, display, and interact with models for non-technical users and support higher-precision editing such as decals, placement, and transforms for experienced users


  • Sticker: Implementing feature where users are able to drop, rotate, reposition, and scale stickers/images seamlessly across curved model surfaces.


  • Real-time Texture Painting (Pen & Brush): Creating a \"Pen & Brush\" tool that allows users to freehand draw directly onto the 3D garment and dynamic UV mapping.


  • Text Manipulation Tools: Building a feature to generate dynamic text (with custom fonts and styling), rasterize it, and project it onto the models as a texture layer.


  • UV Mapping Logic: Handling complex UV wrapping issues to ensure textures, drawings, and patterns wrap around seams and folds naturally without distortion.


  • Asset Ingestion: Build robust logic to support the ingestion of GLB and FBX assets with embedded textures.


Essential Qualifications

  • Expert JavaScript/TypeScript: 5+ years of software development experience with strong proficiency in modern ES6+ syntax.


  • 3D Web Libraries: Extensive commercial experience with Three.js , React Three Fiber (R3F) , or Babylon.js.


  • Graphics Math & Geometry: Solid understanding of Linear Algebra (Vectors, Matrices) and Raycasting logic required for the \"Sticker\", “Material” and \"Painting\" tools.


  • Strong professional experience with Firebase (Firestore, Cloud Functions, Authentication, Hosting, and Storage).


  • Understanding of web application architecture, REST APIs, and client–server communication.


  • Experience with version control systems (Git ) and collaborative development workflows.


  • Good understanding of UI/UX principles, responsive design, and cross-browser compatibility.


  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.


  • Excellent English verbal and written.



Who We Are:

DevGrid is a top-tier software consulting company based in the UK, with a development hub in Brazil and operations spanning Europe and the US. We believe that world-class software can only be created by a motivated and enthusiastic team in an environment that fosters creativity and free thinking. Established in 2015, our mission is to drive innovation and digital transformation by combining our robust business culture and exceptional engineers with forward-thinking business insights.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.



Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?



Qual será o seu papel?

Como Program Manager Sênior, você será responsável por gerenciar um portfólio de múltiplos produtos e iniciativas em diferentes estágios de maturidade, garantindo a entrega de valor estratégico por meio de uma governança híbrida, que combina práticas ágeis e gestão tradicional de PMO.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Supervisionar múltiplos produtos e projetos interdependentes, garantindo o alinhamento com os objetivos de longo prazo da companhia, desde a concepção até a operação ou desativação;
  • Liderar a integração entre as frentes de ativos de infraestrutura, logística (GNL e Biometano) e a mesa de comercialização, otimizando o modelo operacional com visão de cadeia de valor;
  • Atuar com visão de negócio sobre a cadeia de valor, compreendendo o impacto dos ativos estratégicos, a complexidade logística de GNL/Biometano e a dinâmica da comercialização de energia;
  • Implementar e sustentar uma governança híbrida, combinando metodologias ágeis para acelerar entregas com os controles, conformidade e reportes estruturados de um PMO tradicional;
  • Gerenciar a alocação de recursos e a priorização entre produtos em diferentes estágios, da viabilidade à operação;
  • Priorizar demandas estratégicas por meio de pensamento analítico, considerando ambientes de alta complexidade e múltiplas dependências;
  • Traduzir dados técnicos e status dos programas em relatórios e apresentações executivas para C-Level e stakeholders estratégicos;
  • Identificar proativamente riscos, gargalos operacionais ou de infraestrutura, propondo soluções resolutivas e mitigando impactos ao programa.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Graduação em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente, com interação frequente com parceiros internacionais;
  • Sólido domínio de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e de gestão tradicional (PMBOK/PMP);
  • Experiência com gestão do ciclo de vida de produtos e entendimento de modelos de operação e serviços;
  • Vivência em gestão de orçamentos complexos, incluindo CAPEX e OPEX.
  • Proatividade e foco em resolução: atuação orientada à entrega e à remoção de impedimentos para os times de produto;
  • Adaptabilidade e resiliência: capacidade de atuar em um mercado volátil, regulado e com ativos físicos de alta complexidade, ajustando rotas sempre que necessário;
  • Gestão de stakeholders e comunicação executiva: habilidade para atuar como ponto focal junto à diretoria, apresentando visões consolidadas do programa, saúde financeira e marcos críticos, com negociação e clareza em diferentes níveis hierárquicos;
  • Perfil analítico: tomada de decisão orientada por dados, métricas de desempenho e capacidade de desdobrar problemas complexos em planos de ação claros.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir conhecimento em regulação do setor de gás natural e biometano no Brasil;
  • Ter experiência prévia em projetos de expansão de infraestrutura energética;
  • Contar com certificações como PMP, Scrum Master ou SAFe.



O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers


Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

  • Experiência com compliance e integrações com órgãos/fornecedores de dados públicos (ex.: DETRANs, SENATRAN/Serpro) ou terceiros.

  • Assinaturas/bundles, motores de regras e personalização por segmento/UF.
  • Exposição a crédito/score/underwriting no contexto veicular.

title: Power BI Developer
description:
Position: PowerBI Developer

Location: Brazil

Duration: 6 Months


The ideal candidate will have 5–7 years of experience designing and developing interactive dashboards and analytical reports using Microsoft Power BI , along with a strong understanding of supply chain processes and KPIs . This role partners closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and analysts to deliver actionable insights that improve operational efficiency and support strategic decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable Power BI dashboards and reports supporting supply chain functions such as inventory, logistics, procurement, and demand planning.
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications, data models, and visualizations .
  • Build and optimize data models using DAX and Power Query to ensure performance, accuracy, and usability.
  • Collaborate with supply chain teams to define key metrics and KPIs , ensuring accurate and meaningful data representation.
  • Integrate data from multiple sources, including manual inputs, data warehouses, and cloud-based platforms .
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, security, and governance across all Power BI solutions.
  • Implement and manage row-level security (RLS) in self-service and enterprise reporting environments.
  • Conduct Power BI performance tuning and optimization.
  • Provide training, documentation, and ongoing support to business users, enabling self-service analytics.
  • Stay current with Power BI enhancements and industry best practices , recommending continuous improvements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Supply Chain Management , or a related field.
  • 5–7 years of hands-on experience in Power BI development, preferably within supply chain or operations analytics.
  • Strong expertise in DAX, Power Query, and data modeling .
  • Proven experience implementing row-level security (RLS) .
  • Solid understanding of supply chain processes, metrics, and KPIs .
  • Working knowledge of SQL and cloud data platforms such as Azure Synapse or Snowflake .
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., PL-300, DA-100 ) preferred.

title: Head of Growth
description:
This is an ideal role for someone who wants to challenge themselves in a fast-paced environment and join a passionate, driven and fun team. We’re working with one of the leaders in D2C health in the market, Series C, growing 150% YoY, and looking for a Head of Growth to be part of the LatAm set-up (SP-based). Here, you will have the opportunity to manage big budgets and to use your own initiative to follow up on the growth ideas that you have in order to hit the targets that have been set. If you are a self-starter who is looking to accelerate their career and enjoys problem-solving, then this is the ideal role for you! As a Head of Growth, you will have the opportunity to:


Responsibilities:

  • Take full ownership of performance within your projects and campaigns, analysing data, exploring new opportunities, implementing tests and making ongoing optimisations. The idea for this role is that you will move into managing growth holistically for one of our major categories e.g. hair loss, weight loss etc.
  • Manage budgets to drive maximum returns for the business, in line with target KPIs, forecasting spending and acquisition volume within your areas of responsibility.
  • Manage paid campaigns across various channels e.g. Paid Social, SEM.
  • Collaborate with a high-performing Growth team in Brazil and the UK, sharing results and insights on best practices and performance strategies.
  • Develop internal relationships and collaborations with the rest of the UK and BR team, our category managers, customer insights, creative, medical and product team to understand our customers' needs & behaviours and to translate these insights into copy, landing page tests, creatives, new channel tests etc.
  • Ideate test ideas within the channels that you participate in - landing pages, creative, ad copy, bid strategies, pricing etc.
  • Ideate and create performance creative briefs for paid social channels.
  • Test and own new channels that we don’t currently invest in.
  • Build relationships with external vendors (Google, Meta etc..) to understand best practices, new features and campaign improvement opportunities.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years experience working in digital marketing with strong hands-on experience managing campaigns with significant budgets within Paid Social and Search Engine Marketing (SEM).
  • Strong understands a wide variety of digital marketing channels and how they all fit into the overall marketing mix.
  • Advanced knowledge of Meta Ads, Google Ads and Web Analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Familiarity with other channels (TikTok, Twitter, Microsoft, Native, Influencers, SEO, etc.) is a plus.
  • Experience in creative briefing, ad copy and creators/influencers ads.
  • Knowledge of A/B testing, including landing pages.
  • Advanced understanding of data tracking, conversion measurement, attribution and incrementality.
  • Experience with high-growth and/or healthcare businesses is advantageous.
  • Fluent English (mandatory) and Portuguese language skills.


About You:

  • You are a self-starter who can take the initiative, lead a project, own the decisions and proactively look to solve problems.
  • Numbers-oriented, you are highly analytical and love working with data to drive insights and action.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, confident collaborating with multiple stakeholders and managing expectations.
  • Ambitious, keen to learn and ready to grow alongside a rapidly expanding business.
  • You are curious for knowledge, always asking questions, and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.


This role offers very competitive pay , benefits, stock options, and the chance to build something big with an exceptional team and proven product-market fit.


Note: We carefully review every application and will be in touch via LinkedIn or e-mail with candidates whose background best fits what we’re looking for.

title: Especialista em Integrações Oracle & Primavera
description:
Descrição da Posição


Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar de forma estratégica na administração, sustentação, integração e evolução dos sistemas Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) e Oracle Primavera (P6 e Team Member) , suportando os processos de Engenharia, CAPEX, PMO, Projetos Industriais, Manutenção e Operações .


Este profissional será o principal elo entre TI, Engenharia, PMO, Projetos Industriais, Manutenção e Fornecedores , garantindo a fluidez das integrações, governança dos dados e a confiabilidade das informações críticas relacionadas a cronogramas, contratos, planejamento e execução de projetos .


A posição tem papel essencial em todo o ciclo de vida dos projetos industriais , desde a concepção, passando pela execução e comissionamento, até a operação.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Administrar, sustentar e evoluir a plataforma Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) .
  • Desenvolver, configurar, monitorar e dar suporte a integrações entre Oracle Primavera, Oracle Unifier, SAP, SDx, OSI PI e outros sistemas corporativos.
  • Administrar e sustentar o Oracle Primavera P6 e Team Member , assegurando a confiabilidade e integridade dos cronogramas.
  • Apoiar as áreas de PMO e Engenharia na identificação de melhorias de processos e oportunidades de automação.
  • Desenvolver dashboards, relatórios e automações relacionados a progresso físico, CAPEX, contratos e planejamento.
  • Garantir a integridade, disponibilidade e consistência dos dados trafegados via OIC.
  • Organizar e acompanhar incidentes, demandas evolutivas e melhorias , em conjunto com as áreas usuárias.
  • Atuar em projetos de grande porte , como ampliações, novas usinas, turnarounds e CAPEX estruturante.
  • Assegurar aderência às práticas de governança, segurança da informação e arquitetura corporativa .
  • Participar da definição de padrões de integração, APIs, conectores e modelos de dados .
  • Apoiar integrações no ecossistema Engenharia – Projetos – Operação – Manutenção .


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada com Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) , incluindo:
  • Criação e manutenção de integrações
  • Uso de conectores, mapeamento de dados e orquestrações
  • Monitoramento, troubleshooting e governança de integrações
  • Experiência com Oracle Primavera P6 (administração e/ou uso avançado), incluindo:
  • Estruturação de projetos, EAP e calendários
  • Perfis de acesso, segurança e unidades organizacionais
  • Publicação, manutenção e controle de cronogramas
  • Conhecimento e experiência com Primavera Team Member , incluindo configuração e integrações.
  • Experiência em integração de sistemas corporativos (SAP, Oracle, Hexagon, EDMS ou similares).
  • Conhecimento de processos de Engenharia, Projetos, CAPEX, PMO ou Manutenção Industrial .
  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Diferenciais (Não Obrigatórios)

(Modelo idêntico ao OSI PI – apenas diferenciais)


Engenharia Digital / Documentação / Digital Twin

  • SDx (Hexagon) – Digital Twin e engenharia integrada
  • Smart Review 3D (Hexagon) – revisão e navegação 3D
  • Meridian – gestão de documentos de engenharia
  • Smart Completions (Hexagon) – comissionamento e entregas industriais


Dados Industriais e Operação

  • OSI PI System – historiador de dados industriais
  • Experiência com sensores, CLPs, SCADA e integrações OT/IT


CAPEX, Projetos e Portfólio

  • Oracle Unifier – gestão de CAPEX, contratos e workflows
  • Conhecimento em governança de projetos, controladoria e orçamento


Manutenção e Confiabilidade

  • Isoplan – planejamento de manutenção
  • Sentinela / Iris Power / SKF – monitoramento de condição
  • Thermoflow – performance térmica
  • SGI German – qualidade, segurança e meio ambiente


Venha se conectar conosco!

Experiência consolidada (mínimo 5 anos ) em desenvolvimento, arquitetura ou liderança técnica.

Sólidos conhecimentos em Modelagem de Banco de Dados (preferencialmente SQL Server) e linguagem SQL.

Experiência em metodologias ágeis e tradicionais de desenvolvimento.

Manager, Corporate Development


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).

  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.

  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.

title: Business Analyst & Scrum Master (supply chain)
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Hybrid Business Analyst & Scrum Master to support the delivery of Supply Chain Analytics product teams . This role combines deep business and data analysis expertise with Agile leadership to drive insights, improve supply chain performance, and ensure predictable, high-quality delivery.

The successful candidate will partner with planning, logistics, manufacturing, and analytics stakeholders , translating business needs into actionable analytics solutions while facilitating Scrum ceremonies and team execution.

Key Responsibilities

Product & Business Analysis (80%)

  • Partner with Supply Chain stakeholders across Demand Planning, S&OP, Logistics, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Customer Service to gather and define requirements.
  • Translate business problems into analytics solutions including dashboards, KPIs, data marts, and alerts , aligned to the product roadmap.
  • Create and maintain analysis artifacts: user stories, acceptance criteria, BPMN process maps, data dictionaries, and data lineage .
  • Perform data discovery and profiling in Snowflake ; write optimized SQL (CTEs, window functions) and validate data quality against source systems.
  • Review Power BI reports, semantic models, DAX measures , calculation groups, and Row-Level Security (RLS) .
  • Define, monitor, and improve key supply chain KPIs such as forecast accuracy, inventory turns, OTIF, case fill rate, production adherence, DC throughput, and transportation cost per case .
  • Support data governance initiatives including metadata management, access controls, and data quality rules.
  • Contribute to analytics standards, best practices, and documentation.

Scrum Master & Delivery (20%)

  • Serve as Scrum Master for the analytics product team.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies: daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives .
  • Coach teams on Agile principles including transparency, inspection, and iterative delivery .
  • Maintain backlog health and sprint cadence; leverage velocity, cycle time, and burn metrics to forecast delivery.
  • Remove impediments and foster collaboration across business, data engineering, analytics, platform, and security teams .
  • Promote Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) , test automation where applicable, and measurable sprint outcomes.
  • Communicate progress through roadmaps, dashboards, and stakeholder updates.

Required Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in Business Analysis or Analytics roles.
  • 3–5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake, SQL, and Power BI (DAX, RLS, data modeling).
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data quality frameworks .
  • Experience in CPG supply chain domains (demand planning, inventory, production, logistics).
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Must be based in São Paulo, Brazil .

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications: CSM / PSM , PL-300 , SnowPro Core
  • Experience with SAP, Blue Yonder, or Kinaxis
  • Knowledge of S&OP, APS, ERP (SAP ECC/S4), TMS, and WMS data structures and integrations
  • Familiarity with data governance frameworks (stewardship, cataloging, quality rules)

Tools & Environment

  • Snowflake, SQL
  • Power BI (Desktop & Service)
  • Azure DevOps (work management)
  • Data Catalog / Governance tools (e.g., Collibra)
  • ERP / APS / TMS / WMS integrations

Business Impact

  • Improve service levels, inventory turns, forecast accuracy, and cost-to-serve .
  • Increase analytics reliability, scalability, and stakeholder adoption .
  • Enable data-driven decision-making across supply chain functions.

Requirements :

  • Proven experience with e-learning authoring tools (e.g., Articulate, Rise) and Learning Management Systems (LMS) such as Brightspace.
  • Demonstrated success in designing, delivering, and scaling learning programs that drive measurable skill development and business impact.
  • Ability to understand complex or technical information and translate it into clear, engaging, and effective training content.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Highly organized, results-oriented, and able to work independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • Make a direct impact by designing and delivering learning programs that develop global talent, accelerate careers, and drive organizational success.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Caixa
description:
Operador de Caixa (vaga temporária 5x2 em loja de Shopping)


Venha crescer com a Linus!


A Linus é uma marca que tem como propósito tornar o bem-estar um estilo de vida , por meio de escolhas práticas e conscientes. Por isso, se você quer fazer parte de um amanhã mais sustentável - ambiental, social e financeiramente - questionando o status-quo de maneira colaborativa e ética, esta vaga é para você.


o que você vai fazer


1) Registro de vendas e trocas : escanear códigos de barras, inserir preços manualmente ou utilizar sistemas eletrônicos para registrar os produtos adquiridos ou devolvidos pelos clientes.


2) Processamento de pagamentos : receber pagamentos em dinheiro, cartões de crédito/débito, cheques ou outros métodos, calcular o troco e emitir comprovantes de pagamento.


3) Atendimento ao cliente : atender aos clientes com cordialidade, responder dúvidas sobre produtos, preços e promoções, e garantir uma experiência de compra agradável fisicamente e também no canal digital (WhatsApp).


4) Gestão de caixa : abrir e fechar o caixa, conferir valores para evitar inconsistências, manter o local de trabalho organizado e realizar a manutenção básica do equipamento.


5) Emissão de documentos fiscais : emitir notas fiscais ou recibos para os clientes.


6) Gestão de estoque e prevenção de perdas : auxiliar na organização do estoque e na identificação de produtos com problemas, contribuindo para a prevenção de perdas.


7) Comunicação e trabalho em equipe : manter uma comunicação clara com os clientes e com a equipe, buscando soluções para eventuais problemas e colaborando com outras tarefas da loja, quando necessário.



do que você precisa para conquistar a vaga


  • Responsabilidade e proatividade;
  • Boa comunicação;
  • Gostar de moda;
  • Gostar de lidar com pessoas;
  • Comprometimento com as suas atividades, horários e com a empresa;
  • Ter experiência com atendimento ao cliente pode ser um diferencial;
  • Disponibilidade.

  • Vale-refeição;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Jornada por escala 5x2.


Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD). Nos processos seletivos da Linus, não há qualquer tipo de distinção em virtude de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, crença, condição social ou raça.

title: Gerente Regional de Prevenção a Perdas
description:
A AutoZone é a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo ! Empresa Americana, estamos em plena expansão no Brasil, com mais de 150 lojas no país.


A AutoZone inaugurou sua primeira loja AutoZone do Brasil na cidade de Sorocaba em setembro de 2012. Nossa mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e compromisso com Ir Além definem quem somos, tanto para nossos clientes quanto para os AutoZoners. Trabalhar na AutoZone significa fazer parte de uma equipe que valoriza a dedicação, o trabalho em equipe e o crescimento. Esteja você ajudando clientes ou construindo sua carreira, fornecemos ferramentas e suporte para ajudá-lo a ter sucesso e impulsionar seu futuro.


Com mais de 7.000 lojas em operação e presença consolidada em diversos países, a AutoZone é uma referência global no setor de autopeças e acessórios automotivos. No Brasil, seguimos em ritmo acelerado de expansão, com operações em sete estados: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Bahia, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás.


Valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos em ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.


O Gerente Regional de Prevenção a Perdas será responsável por:


Planejar e coordenar as atividades da área de Prevenção de Perdas e Melhoria de Processos, garantindo a definição e o acompanhamento das empresas de segurança que prestam serviços nas lojas AutoZone no Brasil, no Centro de Distribuição e na sede corporativa. Além disso, será responsável por gerenciar análises e propor melhorias nos processos das áreas de Operações e das áreas corporativas, conforme as demandas identificadas.


Atividades:


  • Gerenciar o mapeamento de processos e identificação de riscos e pontos de controle de possíveis perdas, para possibilitar decisões quanto a ações de prevenção.
  • Gerenciar estudos e implantação de dispositivos de prevenção de perdas.
  • Definir e implantar a padronização de procedimentos para organização de estoque da loja, e produtos em displays e prateleiras, a fim de manter os produtos sempre organizados e evitar avarias nas mercadorias, e perdas de produtos perecíveis devido a expiração de seu prazo de validade.
  • Defiir padrões de procedimentos em casos de danos sofridos por equipamentos, materiais ou espaços físicos das lojas.

title: Senior Business Development Specialist
description:
Business Development Representative (Outbound + Nurture):


ContentClicks is a compliance-first growth partner for regulated brands (healthcare, dental, aesthetic medicine, insurance). Our buyers are high-trust, high-standards, and time-poor. That means this is not a “mass blast” role. We run a precise outbound system and we protect founder time with strict qualification.


If you are the type of BDR who wins through targeting, messaging, discipline, and clean CRM execution , you will do very well here. If you rely on spam, shortcuts, or inflated activity numbers, do not apply-we will identify it quickly.


What you’ll do
  • Cold email (primary channel): run outbound campaigns end-to-end-targeting, sequencing, reply handling, objection follow-up, and booking meetings that actually show up.
  • Lead nurture + newsletters: segment and nurture warm leads and the database; run lightweight newsletter/nurture sends that convert “not now” into booked calls.
  • LinkedIn campaigns: execute structured outreach and follow-up aligned to ICP segments (not generic connection spam).
  • Inbound speed-to-lead: respond quickly and professionally to inbound leads (Meta, website forms, guide downloads) and convert them into qualified calls.
  • HubSpot discipline: keep the CRM clean and decision-useful-notes, stages, next steps, required fields, and follow-up tasks. If it’s not in HubSpot, it didn’t happen.
What “great” looks like here
  • You book fewer meetings, but better meetings- correct persona, real intent, clear next steps.
  • Your opportunities get accepted because your qualification is real and your notes are actionable.
  • You work the full cycle: prospect → reply → qualify → nurture → booked call → clean handoff.
Requirements (must-have)
  • Near-native/native English (written and spoken).
  • HubSpot power user (mandatory): pipeline hygiene, tasks, properties, and reporting are second nature.
  • 1–3+ years in outbound BDR/SDR (B2B services or SaaS preferred).
  • You can write cold emails that get responses from senior decision-makers—concise, specific, and professional.
  • You are metrics-driven, but you understand the difference between activity and outcomes .
This role is NOT for you if…
  • You “spray and pray,” blast generic lists, or hide behind volume.
  • Your meetings don’t show up, don’t fit ICP, or don’t convert.
  • You don’t document properly in HubSpot or you dislike process discipline.
Compensation (BRL)
  • Base: R$ 10,900 / month
  • OTE: R$ 27,300 / month
  • This is a performance-heavy plan paid on outcomes (qualified meetings held, sales-qualified opportunities accepted, closed-won assists). Detailed incentive mechanics are shared in the interview process.
To apply (required)

Send:

  • Your CV
  • Your last 90 days results (meetings held, opps created/accepted, wins influenced)
  • One cold email you wrote that performed well (include target persona + why you believe it worked)

description:
Job Title: ITS Business Analyst (Analytics)

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Duration: 18 weeks (Independant Contractor) without benefits

Work Model: Remote

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled ITS Business Analyst (Analytics) to support a critical analytics and data-platform transformation initiative. The ideal candidate will bring 5–7 years of business analysis experience , strong SQL expertise , and hands-on exposure to cloud-based analytics environments .

This role will play a key part in application rationalization and data migration efforts , including the transition from SAP S/4HANA to Snowflake . You will assess current-state analytics solutions, identify data gaps, and support the rebuilding and repointing of dashboards and reports to the future-state data platform.

Agile/Scrum experience is preferred, though Waterfall experience is acceptable .

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather, document, and analyze requirements for analytics and reporting solutions.
  • Review existing analytics applications and support application rationalization initiatives.
  • Assess current-state SAP S/4HANA/HANA data sources and identify future-state data gaps as systems migrate to Snowflake .
  • Support the repointing and rebuilding of dashboards and reports to new cloud data sources.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely; able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Finance Business Partner
description:
Job Title:Finance Business Partner (Brazil)


Job Requirements：

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Finance, Accounting, or a related field
  • 3–5 years of relevant financial experience; candidates with experience in large trading companies, supply chain organizations, financial BP roles, financial analysis, or Brazilian tax-related work are preferred
  • Proficient in Chinese and Portuguese , both can be used as working languages


Key Responsibilities：

1.Budget Management

Support annual budget planning in line with the Group’s budgeting guidelines; communicate budget policies and assist business units in budget preparation, target setting, and execution planning.


2.Business & Financial Analysis

Develop a deep understanding of business operations; analyze financial and operational performance and provide actionable insights and recommendations to support management decision-making.


3.Business Partnership & Collaboration

Work closely with business teams to optimize processes and improve operational efficiency; respond promptly to business project needs and provide financial support.


4.Process & Data Management

Collaborate across departments to streamline workflows, clarify business data logic, and drive process optimization; align business and functional teams on data governance and reporting standards.


5.Finance & Tax Support

Manage financial and tax risks through contract review and payment approval processes; provide professional finance and tax advice and coordinate the resolution of tax-related matters with relevant stakeholders.


6.Financial Training & Enablement

Promote and implement company financial policies and procedures; organize financial training sessions and provide ongoing financial guidance and professional support to business teams.


岗位：财务BP（巴西）

任职要求：

1.学历本科及以上

2.工作经验：3-5年财务工作经验，有大型商贸企业或供应链管理企业财经BP、财务分析、巴西税务处理相关经验者优先。

3.语言：中文和葡语可以作为工作语言


工作内容：

1.预算管理: 按照集团年度预算编制方针，宣导并协助业务部门进行预算编制，并下达预算指标与计划;

2.经营分析: 深入了解业务，根据业务的执行情况提出合理化建议与意见; 分析财务事项，向管理团队提供及时有效的财务状况及经营状况分析;

3.业务协同: 深入业务、通过流程优化，实现业务部门工作高效运行; 快速响应业务部门的项目需求;

4.流程管理: 跨部门流程协作，厘清业务数据及流程优化; 联动业务团队和职能团队，梳理数据逻辑;

5.财税支持: 以合同审核及付款审批工作为基础，为公司把控财税风险，为部门提供财税建议，协调处理业务部门涉及的财务税务相关工作;

6.财务培训: 宣传贯彻公司相关财务制度流程，组织开展财务相关知识培训，为业务部提供财务专业支持与指导。

title: AWS Python Engineer (Production Support)
description:
Role: AWS Python Engineer (Production Support)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Mode: Contract


Experience: Mid-Senior

Key Responsibilities

• Maintain and evolve schema-driven YAML/JSON configurations for distribution and exhibition platforms.

• Support operational workflows by updating internal Python automation scripts.

• Perform database-level investigations to validate data integrity and confirm fixes.

• Work through PR-based change management with clear documentation and regression verification.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery operations.

• Apply observability and log analysis techniques to trace failures and extract actionable insights.

Mandatory Knowledge

• YAML/JSON (production-grade): Safe authoring/refactoring, strict structure, and change hygiene.

• Git + PR workflow: Clean diffs, review discipline, conflict handling, and controlled promotions.

• Schema/validation mindset: Interpreting schema/tooling errors and keeping configs compliant.

• Python: Debugging and adjusting existing scripts/automation; implementing targeted fixes safely.

• Databases (SQL): Querying to investigate production issues, validate data integrity, and confirm outcomes.

• Production support fundamentals: Incident triage, root-cause analysis, mitigations, and regression verification.

• Jinja templating: Understanding template-driven generation and making safe, minimal changes.


Optional Knowledge

• Media Supply Chain fundamentals: Deliverables, packaging concepts, metadata hierarchies, locale conventions, and downstream dependency impacts.

• Advanced mapping/config patterns (conditional/switch/lookup/padding; robust globals/locals usage).

• CI/automation improvements (linting/formatting, pre-validation checks, regression harnesses).

• Partner operations context (common rejection patterns, partner-specific exceptions, operational playbooks).

• Communication in incident/PR contexts (concise updates, change summaries, and requirement translation).


Preferred Experience

• Hands-on experience in production support for large-scale delivery platforms.

• Strong understanding of schema-driven configuration management and automation workflows.

title: Railway Electrical Engineer
description:

We are looking to hire a Railway Electrical Engineer to join our Rail team in Spain.


The selected candidate will be responsible for providing technical leadership in the design of airfields for large-scale international airport projects.

At IDOM, we offer you the opportunity to develop your professional career by actively participating in national and international projects that will challenge you to improve every day, in a collaborative and team-oriented environment. You will join a multidisciplinary group where you will play a key role in project development. You will gain a global perspective on different businesses and technologies in a flexible and trusting work environment.

  • Commitment to long-term professional careers
  • Access to home ownership for all
  • Multicultural and multidisciplinary environment
  • Favorable attitude towards delegation, beyond the usual
  • Mutual commitment
  • Interpersonal relationships that promote unity


ABOUT YOU


Don't hesitate to apply if...


  • You preferably have a degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • You have 5 years of proven experience in railway environments (high speed, metro, tram, etc.). Experience in railway electrification projects in both direct current (DC) and alternating current (AC) is also required, as well as experience in the design, review, and validation of grounding and equipotentiality schemes. The ability to work in multidisciplinary and international environments will be valued.
  • You have in-depth knowledge of stray currents and their mitigation.
  • You are proficient in key European regulations for the railway sector, including EN 50122 (electrical safety and grounding), EN 50121 (electromagnetic compatibility), EN 50119 (catenary), and are familiar with other relevant standards (IEC, EN, etc.).
  • You have the ability to analyze electrical risks, grounding systems, and stray currents, as well as to prepare technical reports, procedures, mitigation strategies, etc.
  • You are fluent in English (minimum level B2/C1) (spoken and written); other languages will be valued.
  • You are a team player, autonomous, flexible, technically rigorous, and internationally minded.
  • And above all... you are eager to learn in an international company like IDOM


ABOUT US


IDOM is an association of professionals whose activity focuses on carrying out engineering, architecture, and consulting projects that contribute to a more sustainable world. The people at IDOM are

connected by our work and by our ownership of the firm, and we cooperate to achieve our greatest professional and personal development and the best service for our clients.

That is why IDOM's core asset is the value and experience of its people. Highly qualified professionals with strong human qualities, deeply united, who work in an environment of respect for their professional identity and freedom, with a strong ambition for progress, development, service, and innovation.

Since our founding in 1957, we have grown steadily and are now a multidisciplinary, integrated, international organization with a presence in 130 countries, where more than 4,300 people carry out our professional activities.


Are you ready to take the next step?

If you join our TEAM, you will be able to develop your career at the highest level, in an environment of deep trust and professional respect.


If you share our philosophy and want to be part of our company, send us your CV.


We want to meet you!

Company Description

Oferecemos experiências digitais humanizadas e hiperpersonalizadas, o que aumenta a geração de receita e a eficiência operacional de nossos parceiros.


Mais informações: Coru Website


Job Description


Como Senior Software Engenieer, você irá liderar a arquitetura e o desenvolvimento da nossa plataforma de orquestração de agentes de IA. A sua missão não é \"reinventar a roda\" no que diz respeito aos LLMs, mas sim construir uma infraestrutura robusta, escalável e flexível que integre as melhores soluções do mercado numa experiência de utilizador perfeita. Será uma peça fundamental na evolução da nossa plataforma para um orquestrador de IA de classe mundial.


Responsabilidades:


1. Arquitetura e Orquestração

  • Design do sistema: arquitetar micros serviços escaláveis e camadas de orquestração que possam lidar com vários fornecedores de IA e fluxos de trabalho complexos de agentes;
  • Estratégia de integração: avaliar e integrar serviços de IA de terceiros (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, etc.), garantindo alta disponibilidade e eficiência de custos;
  • Desenvolvimento de API: projetar e manter APIs de alto desempenho e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos para dar suporte a interações em tempo real com agentes.


2. Full-Stack Development (Node.js/React)

  • Excelência em backend: criar serviços seguros, testáveis e sustentáveis usando NestJS e TypeScript;
  • Integração de frontend: colaborar no frontend Next.js/React para garantir que resultados complexos de IA sejam apresentados de forma intuitiva para os utilizadores;
  • Gestão de bases de dados: projetar e otimizar esquemas de bases de dados relacionais (SQL) para dar suporte à gestão complexa de estados para agentes de IA.


3. Produtividade aumentada por IA

  • Fluxo de trabalho moderno: usar e defender ativamente ferramentas de desenvolvimento baseadas em IA (Cursor, GitHub Copilot) para acelerar a entrega e manter a qualidade do código.

A AutoZone é a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo ! Empresa Americana, estamos em plena expansão no Brasil, com mais de 149 lojas no país.


A AutoZone inaugurou sua primeira loja AutoZone do Brasil na cidade de Sorocaba em setembro de 2012. Nossa mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e compromisso com Ir Além definem quem somos, tanto para nossos clientes quanto para os AutoZoners. Trabalhar na AutoZone significa fazer parte de uma equipe que valoriza a dedicação, o trabalho em equipe e o crescimento. Esteja você ajudando clientes ou construindo sua carreira, fornecemos ferramentas e suporte para ajudá-lo a ter sucesso e impulsionar seu futuro.


Com mais de 7.000 lojas em operação e presença consolidada em diversos países, a AutoZone é uma referência global no setor de autopeças e acessórios automotivos. No Brasil, seguimos em ritmo acelerado de expansão, com operações em sete estados: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Bahia, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás.


Valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos em ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Assegurar o cumprimento das políticas de cargos e salários, identificando alternativas, definindo e sugerindo ações de mudança e inovações, além de implantar e adequar novas práticas de mercado;
  • Gerenciar e orientar para que a prática interna de benefícios e ajudas de custo ocorram de acordo com as práticas do mercado de atuação, alinhando a orientação interna e regional de forma a conceder as devidas condições de trabalho, motivar e reter os Recursos Humanos da empresa.
  • Avaliar e orientar o subsistema de recrutamento e seleção de pessoal, analisando e aprovando propostas de remuneração de novos contratados, conforme políticas internas, visando contribuir para a manutenção da equidade interna e motivação das equipes;
  • Conduzir pesquisas salariais e análises de competitividade para subsidiar decisões de remuneração;
  • Gerenciar programas de remuneração fixa e variável, incluindo bônus, incentivos e políticas de reconhecimento;
  • Apoiar processos de revisão salarial, promoções e movimentações internas, assegurando equidade e governança;
  • Controlar os indicadores de performance da área, proceder à análise dos relatórios das áreas sob sua responsabilidade, analisando os indicadores de performance e demonstrativo de objetivos X resultados alcançados e estabelecendo correções, revisões de estratégias e reorientando, se for o caso, o processo de trabalho.



Requisitos:

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Recursos Humanos, Psicologia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em remuneração e benefícios e gestão de estruturas salariais;
  • Conhecimento em legislação trabalhista e práticas de mercado;
  • Pacote Office Intermediário ou Avançado;
  • Inglês Avançado ou Fluente;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar híbrido na Vila Leopoldina/SP.
